land_use_categories.label: Residential
land_use_categories.table: Table 4 — Maximum FAR by road width
conditions: Source is a secondary copy of the LPA Master Plan 2031 zoning regulations; confirm the official current text and amendments.
The FAR lookup assumes the selected regulatory land-use category is confirmed from the applicable notified land-use map.
Road width must be the legally recognised width of the abutting public road, not a map estimate.
For apartment/group housing sites of 1 hectare or more, the group-housing pathway may apply; SiteIQ switches to the configured group-housing table for a residential-apartment use.
land_use_categories.far_interpretation: Ordinary residential FAR by public road width, unless a special development typology/pathway applies.

conditions: Table 6 of the published plan: 1 hectare or more, approach road at least 12 m.

conditions: The 2026 Premium FAR amendment discussed in the Karnataka High Court judgment permits additional FAR up to 0.6 times ordinary FAR under conditions; this is not automatic and requires premium charge/TDR compliance.

For roads >=9 m but <12 m, the judgment says additional FAR is available only through TDR, not Premium FAR charges. For roads >=12 m, the 0.6× additional FAR ceiling requires a combination of Premium FAR and TDR; exact Table 27 charge/premium mix is not configured.

The judgment identifies amendments for Hoskote, Kanakapura, Anekal, Channapatna, Magadi, Nelamangala, BIAAPA and Ramanagara LPAs. Verify the relevant notification and site eligibility for this exact authority.

setback_low_rise_table.note: Table 2: buildings up to 10 m, by site depth and width. Plots of 4,000 m² and above need at least 5.0 m on all sides.

minimum_all_round_setback.note: Table 2 note: plots of 4,000 m² and above need at least 5.0 m on all sides.

basement_setback_any_size.note: General rules: where the setback exceeds 2.0 m, the basement may extend on all sides except the road side, keeping at least 2.0 m from the boundary.

basement_limits.note: General rules: up to 3 levels for car parking, and none on sites below 200 m².

parking_rule.note: Off-street parking table of the published plan.

electrical_clearance.note: No building below a line or within the horizontal distance from its edge.

building_separation.note: Group housing: the distance between any two buildings is at least half the height of the taller.

accessibility_rule.note: Public and semi-public buildings of 300 m² covered area and above must provide facilities for persons with disabilities.

services_rule.note: Rainwater harvesting is compulsory on plots of 9 m × 12 m and above. The plan also sets solar water heater quantities by use; SiteIQ does not size either.

housing_typology_rule.note: Semi-detached houses need 140 m² of combined plots. Row housing has 3 to 12 units, at least 210 m² combined and at most 108 m² per unit, with setbacks of 2.0 m front, 1.5 m rear and 2.0 m at end units. Coverage and FAR follow the individual plots.
